LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_II_RWP.label: Sten Mk II
LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_II_RWP.description: The Sten Mk II is a simple, rugged submachine gun notable for its low cost and ease of manufacture. Reliable in close-quarters combat, it fires a rapid succession of 9mm rounds, making it an effective choice for short to mid-range engagements. Its straightforward design and quick production time make it a practical option for those needing firepower on a budget.
